Time clock.fact: A time clock, sometimes called a clock card machine, punch clock, or time recorder, is a device that records start and end times for hourly employees (or those on flexi-time) at a place of business. Time complexity.subject: Computer & IT
Time complexity.question: The _____ was Estimate of time taken for running an algorithm.
Time complexity.fact: In theoretical computer science, the time complexity is the computational complexity that describes the amount of computer time it takes to run an algorithm.
